name: Reaper Robustness Fixes
goal: Harden two v1.1.8 reaper defects: _has_push_pending crashing the sweep on a valid-JSON non-object disposition, and the one-time push-pending WARNING never re-arming for a reused workspace_guid.

tasks.name: Reaper robustness (I-1 isinstance guard + I-2 re-arm) + tests
tasks.description: I-1: guard _has_push_pending with isinstance(parsed, dict) so a valid-JSON non-object returns False instead of raising AttributeError out of the sweep. I-2: collect this sweep's push-pending guids in a local seen_push_pending set and prune push_pending_alerted via intersection_update before return counts, re-arming the one-time WARNING for a resolved-then-reused guid. Falsifiable tests: _has_push_pending False for 'null'/'[1]'/'3'; sweep over such a row does not crash; a re-stuck reused guid re-warns after resolution.

steps.description: RED: add test_false_for_valid_json_non_object to TestHasPushPending; add test_sweep_does_not_crash_on_valid_json_non_object_disposition and test_reused_guid_rewarns_after_resolution to TestReapLeakedWorktrees. Re-open the ws db for UPDATEs via sqlite3.connect(str(ws)).
steps.expected: FAIL: AttributeError in _has_push_pending for 'null'/'[1]'/'3'; sweep errors on the 'null' disposition row; re-arm test fails at assert len(third) == 1 (third empty).

steps.description: GREEN I-1: replace _has_push_pending body (main.py:292-296) with parsed = json.loads(...); return isinstance(parsed, dict) and parsed.get('phase') in ('push-pending','push-succeeded','push-failed').

GREEN I-2: init seen_push_pending: set[str] = set() after the resolve_transport default (~main.py:445); add seen_push_pending.add(guid) after counts['push_pending'] += 1 (~:499); add push_pending_alerted.intersection_update(seen_push_pending) immediately before the sweep's final return counts (~:547).
GREEN: run the full reaper suite.
steps.expected: All pass, including the two pre-existing push-pending tests.
